title: 第119章 人皇苏醒第118章 法则崩塌万界同炉
slug: 不是吧这魔修过于正义
content_zh:
此言一出。
众人都炸锅了。
“万界同炉？法则崩塌？！”
“我的天啊！那岂不是意味着，以后我们不仅要防备这种‘把人当资源’的恐怖邪宗，还要面对无数个未知世界的怪物？！”
“这都不是最重要的！重要的是法则之间的相互碰撞，必然会导致毁灭！届时我们所有人都会死！”
这种涉及诸天万界崩坏的浩劫，比他们此前面临的万仙炼世还要让人绝望。
厉惊云眉头紧锁，仰头望向那早已闭合的苍穹。
令人意外的是，他的神色中并没有太多的慌乱。
在短暂的思忖与震惊之后，他深吸了一口气，很快便接受了这个看似天方夜谭的说法。
这也怪不得他如此镇定。
毕竟，他们九霄界可是出了个燕倾！
想当年，在他那个宝贝徒弟燕倾的带领下，九霄界硬生生地逆转了天地乾坤，强行跟高高在上的仙界调换了位置！
连“凡界篡位仙界，脚踩漫天神佛”这种万古未有之大离谱事件他都亲身经历过了，如今再冒出来个“万界融合、高维崩坏”的新危机……
仔细想想，好像也确实没什么值得大惊小怪的。
“肃静！”
厉惊云大袖一挥，所有人顿时安静了。
随后他转过头，目光炯炯地看向凌空而立的姬临，神色肃穆，沉声问道：“小姬，既然令尊能在界域之外观测到这等万界异变，那想必也推演出了这天地大劫的生机所在。你且直说，老阁主可说了解法？”
姬临迎着厉惊云期盼的目光，神色凝重地点了点头，沉声开口。
“解法尚在推演，但家父传音之时，确实给我等留下了破局的方向。”
“首先，诸位无需过度恐慌。”

姬临的声音清晰地传遍全宗：“万界壁垒何其浩瀚坚固，那股崩坏的力量虽然霸道，但想要彻底将诸天万界强行糅合，绝非朝夕之功。距离真正的‘万界同炉’，尚有极其漫长的一段岁月。”
听到“漫长岁月”四个字，在场的众人紧绷的神经终于稍稍放松了一些。
只要不是明天就世界毁灭，那就还有挣扎的余地。
“家父之所以拼着耗费本源跨界传音，并非是为了散播绝望，而是要我等提前布局！”
姬临目光如炬：“大世将倾，变数横生。既然这第一座‘邪宗’已经坠入我九霄界，后续必然还会有更多光怪陆离的世界碎片掉落。我们必须赶在界域彻底融合之前，暗中整合底蕴，推演变局，做好万全的应对之策。唯有如此，才不至于在大劫真正降临时被打个措手不及，沦为劫灰。”
厉惊云微微颔首，深表赞同：“老阁主深谋远虑，理当如此。兵来将挡，水来土掩。那老阁主如今身在何处？可需要我等跨界相助？”
姬临深吸了一口气说道：“家父说……他既已身处天道崩塌的缝隙，那便由他来做这抵御万界崩坏的第一道防线！”
众人心头一震，只听姬临继续说道：
“他老人家，将拼上那条性命去竭力阻止、甚至逆转这一进程，为我等争取时间。他说，昔日他算计苍生、双手沾满了业障，欠下了还不清的血债。如今，以他这残躯去搏一线天机，便算是他的……”
“终极赎罪！”
此言一出。
content_en:
As soon as this statement came out.
Everyone was shocked.
"All worlds are in the same furnace? The law collapses?!"
"Oh my God! Doesn't that mean that in the future we will not only have to guard against this kind of terrifying evil sect that 'treats people as resources', but we will also have to face countless monsters from the unknown world?!"
"This is not the most important thing! What is important is that the collision between laws will inevitably lead to destruction! By then all of us will die!"
This kind of catastrophe involving the collapse of all heavens and realms is even more despairing than the Ten Thousand Immortals Refining World they faced before.
Li Jingyun frowned and looked up at the already closed sky.
Surprisingly, there was not much panic in his expression.
After a brief moment of thought and shock, he took a deep breath and quickly accepted this seemingly impossible statement.
No wonder he was so calm.
After all, there was Yan Qing in their Jiuxiao Realm!
I remember back then, under the leadership of his precious disciple Yan Qing, the Jiuxiao Realm abruptly reversed the course of the world and forcibly changed places with the superior Immortal Realm!
He has personally experienced the unprecedented and outrageous event of "the mortal world usurping the throne of the immortal world and stepping on the gods and Buddhas all over the sky", and now there is a new crisis of "the fusion of all worlds and the collapse of high dimensions"...
Thinking about it carefully, it seems that there is really nothing to make a fuss about.
"Quiet!"
Li Jingyun waved his sleeves, and everyone suddenly fell silent.
Then he turned his head and looked at Ji Lin, who was standing in the sky, with a solemn expression. He asked in a deep voice: "Xiao Ji, since your father can observe such changes in the world outside the realm, he must have deduced the vitality of this great catastrophe. Tell me directly, can the old pavilion master understand the method?"
Ji Lin met Li Jingyun's expectant gaze, nodded solemnly, and spoke in a deep voice.
"The solution is still being deduced, but when my father sent the message, he did leave us with a way to break the situation."
"First of all, there is no need to panic."
Ji Lin's voice clearly spread throughout the whole sect: "The barrier of all realms is so vast and strong. Although the power of collapse is overbearing, it will not be achieved overnight to completely forcibly merge the heavens and all realms. There is still an extremely long period of time before the true 'all realms are in the same furnace'."
After hearing the words "long years", the tense nerves of everyone present finally relaxed a little.
As long as the world does not end tomorrow, there is still room for struggle.
"The reason why my father is spending so much time on cross-border sound transmission is not to spread despair, but to make arrangements for us in advance!"
Ji Lin's eyes were bright: "The world is about to collapse, and there are many changes. Now that the first 'evil sect' has fallen into our Jiuxiao Realm, more bizarre world fragments will inevitably fall in the future. We must secretly integrate the background, push forward the situation, and make complete countermeasures before the realms are completely integrated. Only in this way can we not be caught off guard and reduced to ashes when the catastrophe really comes."
Li Jingyun nodded slightly and agreed deeply: "The old Pavilion Master is far-sighted, and that's what it should be. Soldiers will stop him, and water will cover him up. So where is the old Pavilion Master now? Do you need help from us across the border?"
Ji Lin took a deep breath and said: "My father said... since he is already in the gap between the collapse of heaven and earth, he should be the first line of defense against the collapse of all realms!"
Everyone was shocked when they heard Ji Lin continue to say:
"His old man will risk his life to try to stop or even reverse this process to buy time for us. He said that in the past, he calculated against the people, his hands were full of karma, and he owed a blood debt that he could not repay. Now, using his disabled body to fight for a chance of hope is his..."
"Ultimate atonement!"
As soon as this statement came out.
